about.title: About
about.description: HydroPay is a comprehensive water management solution designed to bridge the gap between utility providers and consumers. Built with a focus on efficiency, transparency, and sustainability.
about.mission: We transform traditional utility management into a seamless digital experience. Our system empowers users with real-time insights into their water consumption while providing administrators with powerful tools for automated billing and smart anomaly detection.
about.smartMonitoringDesc: Automated tracking of meter readings to prevent manual errors and provide instant usage data.
about.intelligentAlertsDesc: Real-time notification systems that detect usage spikes, potential leaks, and overdue payments.
about.transparentBillingDesc: A secure, digital-first approach to financial management, allowing customers to view history and settle balances.
about.reliableSupportDesc: Integrated communication channels connecting customers directly with technical and billing teams.
about.closing: Dedicated to modernizing the way we manage our most precious resource.

blog.title: HydroPay Blog
blog.joinMission: Join HydroPay in our mission to conserve water and protect our natural resources for future generations.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we handle and protect your data
privacy.collection: HydroPay collects essential information such as your name, email address, and water usage data strictly to provide accurate billing services and system notifications.
privacy.usage: Your information is used solely for processing payments, identifying anomalies in usage, and responding to your support inquiries. We never sell your data to third parties.
privacy.security: We implement industry-standard encryption to protect your personal and financial information. Our database is monitored 24/7 to prevent unauthorized access.

terms.title: Terms & Service
terms.notice: Last Updated: April 2026. By using the HydroPay platform, you agree to the following conditions.
terms.responsibilities: Users are responsible for providing accurate meter readings and ensuring timely payments for water services.
terms.payment: All payments are processed securely. Overdue balances may trigger automated system alerts as defined in your service agreement.
terms.liability: HydroPay is a management platform and is not responsible for physical infrastructure failures of the water utility provider.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.description: HydroPay uses cookies to enhance your dashboard experience.
cookies.essential: Required for secure login and account management.
cookies.preference: Used to remember your dashboard layout and filter settings.
cookies.analytics: Help us understand how the system is used to improve performance.
